_worked_example: PAPER. GDD §19.5's second of three. Also the first rung of the soft-cap telegraph (task §6 defect 8): a run could reach day 730 and end with no prior warning at all. Low stakes, 30 days to answer, and answering it costs nothing — the point is that the player hears the clock, not that they act on it.

tr.title: Sektör Telgrafı · yıllık dosya
tr.body:
Yıllık dosya çıkmış. Senin turunda kurulan şirketlerin listesi var; çoğunun yanında bir tur, bir satın alma ya da bir kapanış yazıyor. Senin adının yanında hâlâ ilk gün yazdıkları duruyor.

Dosyayı hazırlayan kişi kimseye bir şey demiyor. Sadece sıralıyor.
tr.expire_unanswered: Sektör Telgrafı'nın yıllık dosyası masanda kaldı.

en.title: Sector Telegraph · the annual file
en.body:
The annual file is out. It lists the companies founded in your cohort, and most of them have a round, an acquisition or a closure written next to the name. Next to yours is still what they wrote on the first day.

Whoever compiled it passes no judgement. They only list.
en.expire_unanswered: The Sector Telegraph's annual file sat on your desk unread.

_port_note: REMOVED FROM THE ARC'S STEP LIST AND MADE ITS OPENER. It starts the arc on EITHER branch — read, or expired unread — because the sector moving on is not conditional on the founder reading about it. A stray `advance_arc` ran BEFORE `start_arc` on the read option — a no-op against an arc that did not exist yet, and if it had run after, it would have skipped the ladder's first rung. The opener starts the arc and nothing else; the arc raises its own steps.
